analyst.summary: SBI Cards is India's leading pure-play credit card company, majority-owned by SBI, and its asset quality is genuinely improving with lower bad-loan and credit-cost ratios. But management itself has flagged a slowdown in new cards and card spending growth to the mid-single digits, so the strong profit growth of recent quarters is being driven more by better credit quality than by business expansion. We rate it a Hold: a well-run, improving-quality lender, but the growth engine has cooled from its earlier pace.
